name: Yohan Go
source:
"Nothing is more beautiful than seeing you try. I like you all just you are."

The school's the most popular student and one of National High School's top 3 geniuses. He is even praised as the most brilliant among them. 
He showers everyone with affection, calling them 'cute baby rabbits'. Many students look up to him and call him 'Lord Yohan'. He calls only the protagonist 'Miss Rabbit', showing her special attention.
